messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
Memory: one remembered fact per line, with the dates it held and the note that recorded it. An indented "earlier" line is a version of the fact above it that was later corrected.
- The Ember team noticed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. (since 2026-05-28; source standup/ember/2026-05-28)
- Team Dune noticed that the auth gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the auth gateway's owners. (since 2026-05-22; source standup/dune/2026-05-22-2)
- The ledger service is not the Atlas team's service, so the Atlas team flagged the ledger service. (since 2026-04-16; source standup/atlas/2026-04-16)
- The Atlas team observed that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change. (since 2026-04-16; source standup/atlas/2026-04-16)
- The Cinder team runs its planning on Mondays. (since 2026-04-03; source standup/cinder/2026-04-03)
- The Cinder team observed that the billing API's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the billing API's owners. (since 2026-03-11; source standup/cinder/2026-03-11-2)
- [constraint] The ledger service has a deploy freeze from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close. (since 2026-03-11; source standup/cinder/2026-03-11)
- [decision] As of 2026-01-30, the Cinder team agreed that auth gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour. (since 2026-01-30; source standup/cinder/2026-01-30)
- [decision] As of 2026-01-12, the billing API is owned by the Ember team, which the Atlas team owned until then. (since 2026-01-12; source handover/2026-01-12-billing-api)
  - earlier: [decision] From 2025-06-09, the billing API is owned by the Atlas team. (held 2025-07-03 to 2026-01-12; source handover/2025-07-03-billing-api-correction)
  - earlier: From 2025-06-09, the billing API is owned by the Boreal team. (held 2025-06-09 to 2025-07-03; source handover/2025-06-09-billing-api)
  - earlier: Since 2025-03-07, the billing API is owned by the Ember team. (held 2025-03-07 to 2025-06-09; source handover/2025-03-07-billing-api)
  - earlier: The billing API is owned by the Atlas team. (held 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-07; source standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2)
- [decision] As of 2025-12-19, the Atlas team owns the product catalog, taking over from the Cinder team. (since 2025-12-19; source handover/2025-12-19-catalog)
  - earlier: The Cinder team owns the product catalog. (held 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-19; source standup/cinder/2025-01-17)
- As of 2025-12-01, the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump, per a heads-up from Boreal team. (since 2025-12-01; source standup/boreal/2025-12-01)
- [decision] As of 2025-11-27, Yuki Tanaka has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Diego. (since 2025-11-27; source standup/cinder/2025-11-27)
  - earlier: [decision] As of 2025-10-24, Diego has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Yuki Tanaka. (held 2025-10-24 to 2025-11-27; source standup/cinder/2025-10-24)
- [constraint] The billing API has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02, the peak season. (since 2025-11-11; source standup/atlas/2025-11-11)
- As of 2025-10-16, the Cinder team sits on the third floor. (since 2025-10-16; source standup/cinder/2025-10-16)
- As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by the Cinder team, not the Atlas team. (since 2025-10-13; source handover/2025-10-13-ledger)
- From 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings the Cinder team, not the Atlas team. (since 2025-10-13; source handover/2025-10-13-ledger)
- [decision] The billing API gates the new invoice flow behind feature-flags, because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. (since 2025-09-30; source standup/atlas/2025-09-30)
- Until 2025-09-23, the reporting service depended on the ledger service for the nightly balance export; it no longer depends on the ledger service. (since 2025-09-23; source standup/dune/2025-09-23)
- As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service uses the bus as its source instead of the ledger service, because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. (since 2025-09-23; source standup/dune/2025-09-23)
- As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler; team Dune owned it until then. (since 2025-09-23; source handover/2025-09-23-scheduler)
